answer: Every claim climbs the bridge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the basalt re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the cipher of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a direct imperative tone, zero filler words, cryptographic jargon register, it stays short.
